headline: Google Quantum AI expands to neutral atom computing: new team at CU Boulder under Dr. Adam Kaufman
details: Announced March 2026. Google adding neutral atom program alongside superconducting roadmap. Led by JILA Fellow Dr. Adam Kaufman at CU Boulder. Three pillars: QEC, Modeling & Simulation, Hardware Development. Collaboration with QuEra (Google portfolio company). Neutral atoms easier to scale in qubit count; superconducting in circuit depth.
relevance_reason: Google's dual modality strengthens neutral atom ecosystem. Modeling & Simulation pillar explicitly relevant to MERA-type holographic simulation. No immediate access path, but research collaboration possible.
access_path: Google Quantum AI collaboration program. Monitor for research access announcements.
